verdict.rationale: AgentMail provides full-text search across threads and an MCP server exposing inbox/message/thread tools that a downstream assistant could use to answer email questions, but it is an email API/infrastructure product, not an assistant itself — there is no built-in natural-language Q&A over an inbox and no calendar integration or 'what's outstanding' reasoning capability mentioned anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: any calendar integration, any native grounded-answer/Q&A assistant experience (only keyword search + raw tool access), and evidence of end-to-end 'ask questions, get grounded answers' behavior rather than raw API primitives.
